title: VU#604762: Multiple vendors vulnerable to Unicode Normalization Collision on macOS (APFS)
description: A vulnerability affecting multiple software vendors arises from a mismatch between Apple File System (APFS) Unicode normalization and application pathname comparisons. This flaw allows local attackers to bypass file exclusion filters or path locks by using alternative Unicode spellings or case-folded variants, enabling unauthorized file overwrites wherever the process has write permissions. The issue impacts archive tools, packaging systems, and runtimes, potentially causing data corruption, configuration hijacking, or code execution. Several CVEs have been assigned, and patches have been issued by some vendors. The CERT/CC recommends updating affected software to the latest versions and implementing path validation consistent with the filesystem's normalization behavior.
